article_content: What you need to know: The three-year-old Pixel 4a phone is getting a surprise security update from Google this month. Google recently rolled out a November 2023 update for its Android 14-powered Pixel phones, including the Pixel 4a 5G and newer models. However, the company also released a security update for the non-5G Pixel 4a. This update is not based on Android 14; the device was not included in the Android 14 supported devices list as it had reached the end of its promised update cycle earlier this year. Although the August 2023 update (Android 13-based) was expected to be the last for the Pixel 4a, Google surprisingly released a new November 2023 update, spotted by Reddit users, with the version number TQ3A.230805.001.S1. Google's November 2023 update was primarily for newer Pixel phones and was the first official update for the Pixel 8 series after their launch with Android 14 in October. The update for the Pixel 4a was not mentioned in Google's Pixel Community post, likely because it's a security patch without noticeable upgrades. It's positive to see Google provide a software update for a three-year-old budget phone despite dropping it from official update support. Pixel 4a owners can check for the update by going to Settings > System > System update and hitting 'Check for update'. Compared to industry standards, the three-year software support for the Pixel 4a was modest. It's encouraging to see Google extend support to seven years for the Pixel 8 series, offering security updates, feature drops, and OS upgrades.

Tačiau bendrovė taip pat išleido saugos atnaujinimą ne '5G' 'Pixel 4a' telefonui. Šis atnaujinimas nėra pagrįstas 'Android 14'; įrenginys nebuvo įtrauktas į 'Android 14' palaikomų įrenginių sąrašą, nes jis jau buvo pasiekęs savo žadėto atnaujinimo ciklo pabaigą anksčiau šiais metais. Nors buvo tikimasi, kad 2023 m. rugpjūčio atnaujinimas (pagrįstas 'Android 13') bus paskutinis 'Pixel 4a', 'Google' netikėtai išleido naują 2023 m. lapkričio atnaujinimą, kurį pastebėjo 'Reddit' vartotojai, su versijos numeriu TQ3A.230805.001.S1. 'Pixel 4a' atnaujinimas nebuvo paminėtas 'Google' 'Pixel Community' pranešime, tikriausiai dėl to, kad tai yra saugos pataisa be pastebimų patobulinimų. 'Pixel 4a' savininkai gali patikrinti atnaujinimą eidami į Nustatymai > Sistema > Sistemos atnaujinimas ir paspausdami 'Tikrinti atnaujinimus'. Tai padrąsina, kad 'Google' pratęsė paramą iki septynerių metų 'Pixel 8' serijai, siūlydamas saugos atnaujinimus, funkcijų atnaujinimus ir OS atnaujinimus.

article_content: Forecasters at 'Colorado State University' predict an 'above average' 2013 hurricane season with 18 tropical storms, 9 of which are expected to intensify into hurricanes. The prediction is based on two main factors: the recent warming of the 'Atlantic Ocean' and the low expectation of an 'El Nino' effect during the summer and fall. Historically, an average hurricane season sees 12 tropical storms, 6 hurricanes, and 2 major hurricanes between 'June 1' and 'November 30'. The researchers indicate a 72% chance that a major hurricane will hit the 'U.S. coast', significantly higher than the historical average of 52%. The likelihood of a major hurricane impacting the 'U.S. East Coast' is 48%, up from the average of 31%, while the 'Gulf of Mexico' coast faces a 47% chance, compared to the average of 30%.

Prognozė grindžiama dviem pagrindiniais veiksniais: neseniai sušilusiu 'Atlanto vandenynu' ir maža 'El Nino' efekto tikimybe vasarą ir rudenį. Istoriškai, vidutinis uraganų sezonas tarp 'birželio 1 d.' ir 'lapkričio 30 d.' patiria 12 atogrąžų audrų, 6 uraganus ir 2 didelius uraganus. Tyrėjai nurodo, kad yra 72% tikimybė, jog didelis uraganas pasieks 'JAV krantą', tai yra žymiai daugiau nei istoriškai vidutiniškai 52%. Didelio uragano tikimybė 'JAV Rytų pakrantėje' yra 48%, pakilusi nuo vidutinio 31%, o 'Meksikos įlankos' pakrantė susiduria su 47% tikimybe, palyginti su vidutiniškai 30%.

article_content: Professor Brian Cox states that his fame as a scientist exceeds his previous popularity as a pop star. He teaches at Manchester University and advocates for scientists being celebrated figures to boost public interest in science. Cox references 19th-century British scientists like Michael Faraday and Humphry Davy as examples of celebrated academics. He believes that making academics celebrities again can spark public interest in scientific ideas. Cox is confident that his students won't be star-struck; instead, they might critique his teaching style. His TV shows, such as 'Wonders of Life,' have attracted large audiences, and he is involved in the ATLAS experiment at CERN.

'Kodėl gi nepadaryti akademikų garsenybėmis?' - klausia Cox, siūlydamas, kad tai gali būti būdas sužadinti visuomenės susidomėjimą mokslu. Jis mano, kad jo studentai greičiau kritikuos jo dėstymo stilių, nei bus sužavėti. Jo televizijos laidos, tokios kaip 'Wonders of Life,' sulaukė didelio populiarumo.

article_content: (CNN) ISIS has apparently taken a significant hit over the past several days. The bodies of at least 70 fighters from the terror group were dropped off at a hospital in Tal Abyad, a Syrian town on the Turkish border, over four days, according to a Syrian opposition group. Tal Abyad is about 80 kilometers (50 miles) from Raqqa, which ISIS took control of last year and uses as a headquarters. Kurdish and Iraqi forces, backed by airstrikes from an international coalition led by the US, are battling ISIS and focusing on retaking Kobani, a Kurdish town on the Syrian-Turkish border. It's unclear who dropped the bodies off at the hospital, but it was likely other ISIS fighters. Sources confirmed the events to the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights. Kobani is currently the scene of an intense battle, with ISIS shelling the city and coalition planes flying overhead. US Central Command Gen. Lloyd Austin stated that the strategy against ISIS is working but warned that it will take 'strategic patience' to defeat them.

Tal Abyad yra apie 80 kilometrų (50 mylių) nuo Rakos, kurią 'ISIS' užėmė praėjusiais metais ir naudoja kaip būstinę. Kurdų ir Irako pajėgos, palaikomos tarptautinės koalicijos, vadovaujamos JAV, oro antskrydžių, kovoja su 'ISIS' ir siekia atsiimti Kobanį, kurdų miestą prie Sirijos ir Turkijos sienos. Neaišku, kas atgabeno lavonus į ligoninę, bet tikėtina, kad tai padarė kiti 'ISIS' kovotojai. Šaltiniai patvirtino įvykius Sirijos žmogaus teisių stebėtojams. JAV centrinio vadovavimo generolas Lloydas Austinas pareiškė, kad strategija prieš 'ISIS' veikia, bet perspėjo, kad norint juos nugalėti, prireiks 'strateginio kantrybės'.

article_content: A federal court in Minneapolis sentenced two women, Amina Farah Ali and Hawo Mohamed Hassan, to significant prison terms for raising funds for Somali militants under the guise of charity. The women, naturalized U.S. citizens originally from Somalia, collected donations by going door-to-door in Somali communities in the U.S. and Canada. Ali, 36, received a 20-year sentence on multiple terror-related charges, including supporting Al-Shabaab. Hassan, 66, was sentenced to 10 years for conspiring to support a terrorist group and providing false information to authorities. Evidence presented showed that between 2008 and 2009, they supported Al-Shabaab by hosting teleconferences and encouraging donations to the militant group instead of charitable causes.

Moterys, natūralizuotos JAV pilietės iš Somalio, rinko aukas Somalio bendruomenėse JAV ir Kanadoje, eidamos nuo durų prie durų. 36 metų Ali gavo 20 metų bausmę už daugelį teroro nusikaltimų, įskaitant Al-Shabaab rėmimą. 66 metų Hassan buvo nuteista 10 metų už sąmokslą remti teroristų grupuotę ir teikė klaidingą informaciją valdžios institucijoms. Iki šiol pateikti įrodymai parodė, kad jie 2008–2009 metais rėmė Al-Shabaab, rengdami telekonferencijas ir skatindami aukoti militantų grupuotei.

article_content: President Barack Obama has renewed his call for a comprehensive overhaul of the US immigration system, emphasizing the need for bipartisan cooperation to tackle an issue that has long been a source of deep social and political division. Speaking at American University in Washington, Obama highlighted the significant contributions immigrants have made to America's history and progress, while acknowledging the widespread frustration with a system seen as 'fundamentally broken'. Obama specifically targeted Arizona's new immigration law, arguing it intensifies an already heated debate and could lead to violations of the rights of American citizens and legal residents. The president outlined a reform plan requiring those who entered the US illegally to acknowledge their actions, register with authorities, pay taxes and a fine, and learn English as steps towards earning citizenship.

Amerikos universitete Vašingtone kalbėjęs Obama pabrėžė imigrantų indėlį į Amerikos istoriją ir pažangą, kartu pripažindamas plačiai paplitusią nepasitenkinimą 'iš esmės suirusia' sistema. Obama kritikavo Arizonos įstatymą, teigdamas, kad jis dar labiau kaitina diskusijas ir gali pažeisti Amerikos piliečių teises. Prezidentas pasiūlė reformos planą, kuriuo siekiama, kad nelegaliai atvykę asmenys pripažintų savo veiksmus, registruotųsi, mokėtų mokesčius, mokėtų baudą ir išmoktų anglų kalbą.

article_content: To beat the London Olympics congestion, an international delivery service is turning to a team of runners. With nearly five million visitors expected between July 27 and August 12, along with strict security and special Olympic lanes for athletes and staff, navigation is anticipated to be challenging. German express delivery service DHL has enlisted London-based JogPost's team of foot couriers to ensure timely package delivery. JogPost co-founder JJ Harding described his approximately 400 runners as 'congestion-busters,' saying, 'During Olympic chaos, we'll still deliver crucial documents to businesses.' London's transport infrastructure is identified as a significant risk to the games' smooth operation. DHL stated that traffic is expected to increase by 30 percent on core routes. With reserved traffic lanes for Olympics officials, foot couriers could be a speedy alternative for urgent packages. article_content: A 93-year-old man from Lower Saxony, Germany, has been charged with being an accessory to murder in at least 300,000 cases for his alleged actions at the Auschwitz concentration camp during the Nazi era. His role is believed to have involved the removal of luggage from new arrivals at Birkenau and the processing of cash found in the belongings, which was sent to Nazi headquarters. The charges are related to the 1944 Nazi operation to deport Jews from Hungary, resulting in at least 300,000 deaths upon arrival at Auschwitz-Birkenau. This is not the man's first charge; he was previously accused in 1985, but the case was dismissed due to lack of evidence. A regional court will now determine whether the case will go to trial, with several survivors and relatives applying to be secondary plaintiffs.

'Jis tariamai dalyvavo naujų atvykėlių bagažo pašalinime Birkenau platformoje ir rastų pinigų apdorojime, kurie vėliau buvo siunčiami į Berlyną.' 'Kaltinimai susiję su 1944 m. nacių operacija, kai buvo deportuoti žydai iš Vengrijos, dėl ko mažiausiai 300 000 žmonių buvo nužudyti atvykus į Aušvicą-Birkenau.' 'Tai ne pirmas šio vyro kaltinimas; 1985 m. jis jau buvo kaltintas, bet byla buvo nutraukta dėl įrodymų stokos.' 'Dabar regioninis teismas nuspręs, ar byla bus perduota teismui, o keli išgyvenę asmenys ir jų giminaičiai prašė teisės dalyvauti byloje kaip antriniai ieškovai.'

article_content: (CNN) -- An extra time goal from Brazilian midfielder Jadson ensured Ukrainian side Shakhtar Donetsk won the last ever UEFA Cup final with a 2-1 victory over Bundesliga side Werder Bremen in Istanbul. Jadson celebrates his winning goal as Shakhtar Donetsk became the final team to lift the UEFA Cup. Jadson's strike from 15 yards out lacked pace, but Werder goalkeeper Tim Wiese failed to save the shot and it slipped through his grasp to trickle over the line. However, there was drama in the final minute of extra time when Werder striker Claudio Pizarro thought he had taken the final into a penalty shoot-out, but the goal was ruled out after the on-loan Chelsea forward was adjudged to have tugged back defender Dmytro Chygrynskiy before nudging the ball home. The victory means Mircea Lucescu's side became the first team from Ukraine to lift a major European trophy and gives eastern Europe a third UEFA Cup in five years after recent successes for Russian sides CSKA Moscow and Zenit St Petersburg. Next season, the competition is being rebranded and renamed to become the Europa League. Shakhtar were always the classier of the two sides and they should have gone ahead in the fifth minute when Luiz Adriano was allowed time and space to turn on the edge of the box, but he fired just wide with the goal gaping. He was almost made to pay a minute later as Shakhtar failed to clear Sebastian Boenisch's long throw, but Frank Baumann miscued his effort. However, Adriano made amends for his earlier miss in the 24th minute when he seized on a through-ball that had wrong-footed the Bremen defence and lifted a superb chip over the onrushing Wiese. Moments after his goal, Luiz Adriano found himself on the corner of the box again but lashed the ball over the bar, and his compatriot Willian then broke purposefully into the box, only to produce a tame finish straight at Wiese. But just as Shakhtar were threatening to extend their advantage, Bremen hit back through their own Brazilian, Naldo. The defender stepped up to take a 34th-minute free-kick, striking it so hard that goalkeeper Andrei Pyatov could only help it on its way into the net. At the other end, Wiese looked more assured in denying Mariusz Lewandowski's powerful strike, and the teams went in level at the end of an absorbing first half. Wiese was back in action soon after the restart, doing well to punch away Darijo Srna's free-kick from the right and Jadson's strike from the left. With the game petering out, extra-time looked increasingly likely, and once it got underway, it was almost inevitable that it would be an error that would finally settle the issue. Less predictable was that Wiese would be the culprit, horribly misjudging Jadson's soft shot from 12 yards and undoing all his good work through the night by letting it bobble past him into the net.

Jadsonas švenčia savo pergalingą įvartį, kai 'Shakhtar Donetsk' tapo paskutine komanda, kuri iškovojo UEFA taurę. Jadsono smūgis iš 15 jardų trūko greičio, tačiau 'Werder' vartininkas Tim Wiese nesugebėjo išsaugoti kamuolio ir jis nuriedėjo per liniją. article_content: A Florida couple, Bogdan and Elizabeth Makowski, were rescued at sea after their '76 Almond Hunter boat's engine failed and winds died down. The couple, aged 69 and 61, had set sail near Anclote Key. Mr Makowski was initially unperturbed by the engine failure, stating, 'The engine stopped after four hours. I don't care because I am sailing.' However, the lack of wind hindered their progress. Having informed a friend about their sailing plans, the friend alerted the Coast Guard when they failed to return on time. The couple faced dire conditions: no food, limited water, and a damaged sail. They managed to sail closer to shore using a remnant of their sail and were rescued 10 miles northwest of Anclote Key. The Coast Guard found them in good condition, and they were transferred to Anclote River Boat Ramp. Despite the ordeal, the couple plans to restore their boat and sail again next season.

Man tai nesvarbu, nes plaukiu burlaiviu.' Tačiau vėjas sutrukdė jų pažangą. Jie buvo informavę draugą apie savo planus, ir draugas įspėjo pakrantės apsaugą, kai jie laiku negrįžo. Pora susidūrė su sunkumais: neturėjo maisto, vandens buvo mažai, o burė buvo pažeista. Naudodamiesi likusia burės dalimi, jie sugebėjo priplaukti arčiau kranto ir buvo išgelbėti už 10 mylių į šiaurės vakarus nuo Anclote Key. Pakrantės apsauga juos rado geros būklės ir perkėlė į Anclote upės valtų rampą. Nepaisant išgyvenimų, pora planuoja atkurti laivą ir vėl išplaukti kitą sezoną.

article_content: A '$700 million foreign takeover of Wotif.com by Expedia could increase accommodation costs in Australia', the hotels industry warns. The takeover, expected by the end of October, will concentrate Australia's online travel booking market into the hands of two US giants: Expedia and Priceline, which owns Booking.com and Agoda. Industry spokesman Bradley Woods said the two operators will control around '85 per cent' of the market, likely resulting in higher advertising charges for hotels. 'Australian hotel rooms could end up more expensive,' he said. The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) has cleared the deal, noting the emergence of smaller online travel agents and websites like TripAdvisor and Google Hotels Finder. Wotif.com welcomed the ACCC's decision.

Pramonės atstovas Bradley Woods teigė, kad du operatoriai - 'Expedia' ir 'Priceline' - kontroliuos apie '85 procentus' rinkos, kas gali lemti viešbučiams didesnes reklamos išlaidas. 'Australijos viešbučių kambariai gali pabrangti,' jis perspėjo. ACCC nepriekaištavo dėl perėmimo, nurodydama naujų mažų kelionių agentūrų atsiradimą.

article_content: As Diwali approaches, London's 'Little India' in Southall is bustling with activity. Hindus and Jains are preparing to celebrate the festival, while Sikhs are marking Bandi Chhor Divas. Mainstream supermarkets now have dedicated Diwali aisles, a trend that has sparked concern among local, family-run businesses. They feel that this commercialisation is impacting their revenue. Indy Sira of Sira's Cash and Carry, a family business that has been around for over 50 years, expressed that Diwali is a special time but feels that supermarkets are 'capitalising' on the festival without acknowledging the efforts of local businesses. On the other hand, some Londoners believe that supermarkets make Diwali more accessible and introduce the celebration to other communities. Tesco Southall's community champion, Madhu Rana, highlighted the store's evolving approach to catering to diverse religious celebrations.

Didelės parduotuvės dabar turi specialias Diwali sekcijas, tai sukėlė nerimą tarp vietinių, šeimos valdomų parduotuvių. Jie mano, kad ši komercializacija kenkia jų pajamoms. Indy Sira iš 'Sira's Cash and Carry', šeimos verslo, veikiančio daugiau nei 50 metų, pasakė, kad Diwali yra ypatingas laikas, bet atrodo, kad parduotuvės 'naudojasi' švente neįvertindamos vietinių parduotuvių pastangų. Kita vertus, kai kurie Londono gyventojai mano, kad parduotuvės daro Diwali prieinamesne ir supažindina kitas bendruomenes su švente.

article_content: A powerful 7.3-magnitude earthquake hit the Fiji islands region in the Pacific Ocean early Friday, according to the U.S. Geological Survey. The Pacific Tsunami Warning Center stated that 'a destructive tsunami was not generated, based on earthquake and historical tsunami data.' The quake occurred at a depth of 626 kilometers, or approximately 390 miles below the earth's surface. Its epicenter was located 74 miles south-southwest of Ndoi Island, 281 miles south-southeast of Suva, the Fijian capital, and 264 miles west of Nuku'alofa in Tonga. The earthquake happened just after 7:30 a.m. local time, or 3:30 p.m. ET. Initially, it was reported as a 7.2 magnitude quake. Both the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center and the Japan Meteorological Agency did not issue any tsunami warnings or advisories.

Ramiojo vandenyno cunamio įspėjimo centras pareiškė, kad 'destruktyvus cunamis nebuvo sukeltas, remiantis žemės drebėjimu ir istorinių cunamių duomenimis.' Drebėjimas įvyko 626 km gylyje, apie 390 mylių žemiau žemės paviršiaus. Jo epicentras buvo 74 mylios į pietus-pietvakarius nuo Ndoi salos, 281 mylia į pietus-pietryčius nuo Suva, Fidžio sostinės, ir 264 mylios į vakarus nuo Nuku'alofa Tongoje. Žemės drebėjimas įvyko iškart po 7:30 ryto vietos laiku, arba 15:30 ET. Pradžioje jis buvo praneštas kaip 7.2 magnitudės žemės drebėjimas. Tiek Ramiojo vandenyno cunamio perspėjimo centras, tiek Japonijos meteorologijos agentūra nebuvo išleidę jokių cunamio įspėjimų ar patarimų.

article_content: By Corey Charlton. A wealthy businessman is furious with Morrisons after his brand new £75,000 BMW was damaged by the supermarket's car wash. David Elliott was in his 6 Series Gran Coupe when the back window shattered seconds after he paid £6.99 for a wash and wax. The 48-year-old realised part of the car wash had snagged on his BMW's boot. Instead of the safety mechanism working, the roller continued to rise, pushing the boot into the back window. Elliott's BMW was damaged after going through the Morrisons car wash in Evesham. Mr Elliott had parked inside when he heard a loud 'splintering' sound. He drove out to check the damage to his pride and joy, which he had bought two months earlier. He's been quoted £4,000 to fix the damage and has had to put the BMW in a garage and cycle 16 miles to work. Today, the dad-of-two criticised Morrisons, which he claims is refusing to accept liability. A Morrisons spokesperson said the company's investigation is ongoing. Elliott said: 'I was typing an email on my phone and heard a splintering sound. Then I heard a crunching noise as the boot was forced open. The car wash thrust it forward through the back window.' Mr Elliott said the car window smashed seconds after he paid £6.99. The BMW, a 6 Series Gran Coupe, cost £75,000 and was only two months old. 'I called Morrisons customer services, and within a week, they denied liability. An engineer checked the car wash and said it was fine.' Elliott spoke to the car wash manager and then phoned customer services. Elliott added: 'It makes you think what could have happened if my kids were in the back. I want to take it to the small claims court.' A Morrisons spokesperson said their investigation is ongoing.

David Elliott buvo savo 6 Series Gran Coupe, kai galinis langas sudužo praėjus sekundėms po to, kai jis sumokėjo £6.99 už plovimą ir vaško padengimą. 48-metis pastebėjo, kad dalis automobilių plovimo įrenginio užkliuvo už jo BMW bagažinės. Ponas Elliott įvažiavo į plovimo zoną, kai išgirdo 'traškėjimą'. Jis išvažiavo laukan patikrinti žalos savo automobiliui, kurį buvo nusipirkęs prieš du mėnesius. article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) -- Violence and heavy metal have been linked since the genre's inception. Accusations that the Columbine killers were influenced by Marilyn Manson's music were later found to be false. Bands like Judas Priest, Marilyn Manson, and Black Sabbath have faced public backlash for allegedly inciting teenagers to commit murder and suicide. The international media has been quick to draw connections between violent acts and heavy metal, even when evidence contradicts this. For Sam Dunn, an anthropologist and documentary filmmaker who identifies as a 'metalhead,' heavy metal is often used as a scapegoat to avoid addressing more complex societal issues. 'People look at heavy metal and label it because we need simple answers to complex questions,' Dunn explains. Heavy metal lyrics often contain graphic content, but fans argue this is not meant to be taken literally. As one Norwegian metal fan noted, 'It's all fantasy, none of this is real.' Experts and fans alike compare the genre's imagery to that found in horror movies, suggesting it's part of the 'show.' Iron Maiden's Bruce Dickinson attributes the genre's themes to his upbringing on '70s horror movies. The band has faced controversy, particularly over their 1982 album 'The Number of the Beast,' but insists their work is about storytelling, not devil worship. Despite controversy, fans describe the heavy metal community as polite and respectful.

Teiginiai, kad Kolumbino žudikai buvo paveikti Marilyn Mansono muzikos, vėliau buvo paneigti kaip neteisingi. Grupės, tokios kaip Judas Priest, Marilyn Manson ir Black Sabbath, susidūrė su viešu nepasitenkinimu dėl tariamo skatinimo paauglius žudyti ir žudytis. Tarptautinė žiniasklaida greitai sieja smurtinius aktus su sunkiuoju metalu, net kai tam prieštarauja įrodymai. Sam Dunn, antropologas ir dokumentinių filmų kūrėjas, save vadinantis 'metalhead,' teigia, kad sunkusis metalas dažnai naudojamas kaip koziris, siekiant išvengti sudėtingesnių visuomenės problemų. 'Žmonės žiūri į sunkųjį metalą ir jį kaltina, nes mums reikia paprastų atsakymų į sudėtingus klausimus,' aiškina Dunn. Sunkausio metalo dainų tekstuose dažnai yra grafinio turinio, tačiau gerbėjai teigia, kad tai nėra skirta būti suprantama pažodžiui. Vienas Norvegijos metalo gerbėjas pažymėjo, 'Visa tai fantazija, niekas iš tiesų nėra realu.' Ekspertai ir gerbėjai lygina žanro vaizdinius su siaubo filmų vaizdiniais, teigdami, kad tai yra dalis 'šou.' Iron Maiden vokalistas Bruce Dickinsonas šio žanro temas sieja su savo vaikyste ir '70-ųjų siaubo filmais. Grupė susidūrė su kontroversijomis dėl savo 1982 m. albumo 'The Number of the Beast,' bet tvirtina, kad jų darbas yra apie pasakojimą, o ne apie velnų garbinimą. Nepaisant kontroversijų, gerbėjai apibūdina sunkaus metalo bendruomenę kaip mandagią ir pagarbiai nusiteikusią.

article_content: As impressive as the Mars Curiosity's findings have been, the rover doesn't have the capability to explore further out in the solar system due to significant communication delays. Nasa faces a substantial communication delay when sending its agenda to the Mars rover each Martian day. Instructions from Earth take about 20 minutes to reach Mars, making real-time control impossible. On Jupiter's moon Europa, this delay increases to over 90 minutes. TextureCam, an 'intelligent' camera, can analyze images and make decisions autonomously. It uses a two-lens device to capture 3D images and a special processor to analyze them. The processor distinguishes between sand, rocks, and sky by recognizing textures. When TextureCam identifies an interesting rock, it can upload a high-resolution image or instruct the rover to take a sample. 'We have a micromanaging approach to space exploration,' said Kiri Wagstaff, a geologist at JPL California. TextureCam was trained using real Martian images and tested in the Mojave Desert.

Nasa susiduria su dideliu komunikacijos vėlavimu, siųsdama savo darbotvarkę 'Mars' roveriui kiekvieną Marso dieną. Instrukcijos nuo Žemės iki Marso paviršiaus keliauja apie 20 minučių, todėl realaus laiko valdymas tampa neįmanomas. Jupiterio mėnulyje Europoje šis vėlavimas padidėja iki daugiau nei 90 minučių. TextureCam, 'intelektualus' fotoaparatas, gali analizuoti vaizdus ir priimti sprendimus autonomiškai. Jis naudoja dviejų objektyvų įrenginį 3D vaizdams fiksuoti ir specialų procesorių jų analizei. Procesorius atskiria smėlį, uolienas ir dangų, atpažindamas tekstūras. Kai TextureCam aptinka įdomią uolieną, jis gali įkelti aukštos raiškos vaizdą arba nurodyti roveriui paimti mėginį. 'Mes turime mikrovaldymo požiūrį į kosmoso tyrinėjimus,' sakė Kiri Wagstaff, geologė iš JPL Kalifornijoje. TextureCam buvo apmokyta naudojant realius Marso vaizdus ir išbandyta Mojave dykumoje.

article_content: US-based Ethiopian artist Julie Mehretu has broken the record for the highest sale price of any work by an African-born artist at auction. Her abstract painting 'Walkers With the Dawn and Morning' fetched $10.7m (£8.6m) at Sotheby's in New York on Wednesday. The piece, featuring ink and acrylic on canvas, takes its name from a 1920s Langston Hughes poem. Mehretu, born in Ethiopia in 1970/1971 (52 years old as of the sale), moved to the US with her family in 1977. She has become a prominent figure in the contemporary African art world. 'Walkers With the Dawn and Morning' was created as part of an exhibition responding to Hurricane Katrina's impact on New Orleans in 2005. The auction saw two bidders competing, driving the price up from $9.5m to $10.7m including fees. Sotheby's described the work as combining 'all aspects of her inimitable style of mark making'. The sale indicates a strong interest in contemporary African art, with a growing market for abstract work. Mehretu also held the previous record of $9.3m, set last month. Earlier this year, she was chosen to create BMW's next Art Car, which will be part of the 24 Hours of Le Mans race next year.
translated_content: JAV įsikusi etiopų kilmės dailininkė 'Julie Mehretu' vėl sumušė rekordą už aukščiausią kainą, už kurią buvo parduotas Afrikos kilmės menininko kūrinys aukcione. Jos abstrakti tapyba 'Walkers With the Dawn and Morning' buvo parduota už $10,7 mln. (£8,6 mln.) 'Sotheby's' aukcione Niujorke trečiadienį. Kūrinys, sukurtas tušu ir akrilu ant drobės, pavadintas pagal 1920-ųjų metų poeto Langstono Hjuiso poemą. Mehretu, gimusios Etiopijoje apie 1970/1971 m., šeima 1977 metais persikėlė į JAV. Ji tapo vienu žinomiausiu vardu sparčiai augančiame šiuolaikinio Afrikos meno pasaulyje. 'Walkers With the Dawn and Morning' buvo nutapyta kaip parodos, skirtos uragano 'Katrina' 2005 metais poveikiui Naujajame Orleane, dalis. Aukcione du pirkėjai varžėsi dėl kūrinio, todėl kaina pakilo nuo $9,5 mln. iki $10,7 mln. įskaitant mokesčius. 'Sotheby's' apibūdino kūrinį kaip 'visų jos unikalaus stiliaus aspektų derinį'. Šio kūrinio pardavimas rodo didelį susidomėjimą šiuolaikiniu Afrikos menu, kurio rinka auga. Mehretu taip pat priklausė ankstesnis rekordas - $9,3 mln., pasiektas praėjusį mėnesį. Šių metų pradžioje ji buvo pasirinkta sukurti BMW 'Art Car', kuris dalyvaus '24 Hours of Le Mans' lenktynėse kitais metais.

article_content: A late goal saved Ivory Coast's blushes as they secured a draw against Mali in the Africa Cup of Nations on Saturday, keeping them on course for a place in the quarter finals. Mali took an early lead after striker Bakary Sako, who plays for Wolverhampton Wanderers in the English Championship, powered home a right-foot volley from close range. The goal looked to have been enough for Mali, who defended stoutly against an Ivory Coast team featuring Manchester City's Yaya Toure and Wilfried Bony. But The Elephants pushed hard for an equalizer. Winger Max-Alain Gradel scored with seven minutes remaining to equalize. Ivory Coast are now top of the group on two points with one game to play. Despite the late goal, Ivory Coast's French coach Herve Renard was unhappy with some of the officiating, especially a first-half penalty appeal for a foul on Wilfried Bony. 'I won't talk about it, but I was not upset with my players. I think you can understand what I was upset about, but now it's too late to talk about that,' Renard told AFP. 'I don't like creating controversy afterwards. It leads to being suspended. I need to remain calm,' he added. Group D's other two teams, Cameroon and Guinea, played out a 1-1 draw. Cameroon took the lead when Benjamin Moukandjo's corner went straight in, and Ibrahima Traore leveled the match before half-time. The group is delicately poised going into the final round of games, with all four teams on two points after four consecutive 1-1 draws.

Malio komanda pirmavo po Bakary Sako tikslaus smūgio dešine koja. Įvartis atrodė pakankamas Maliui, kuris gynėsi prieš Dramblio Kaulo Kranto komandą su Yaya Toure ir Wilfried Bony. 'Aš nekalbėsiu apie tai, bet nebuvau nepatenkintas savo žaidėjais', - sakė Renard. Kamerūnas ir Gvinėja sužaidė 1-1. Benjamin Moukandjo kampinis smūgis įskriejo į vartus, o Ibrahima Traore išlygino. article_content: Friday, November 17, 2023 For Immediate ReleaseOffice of Public Affairs A federal jury in Beaumont, Texas, convicted a Romanian national today for plotting to traffic hundreds of kilograms of cocaine from the 'United States Postal Service' in a scheme that also included 'forging postal stamps' and an attempt to assassinate 'prominent businessmen' in Romania. According to court documents and evidence presented at trial, Marius Lazar, 50, of Bucharest, Romania, was a 'founding member' of his local chapter of the Hells Angels Motorcycle Club, a transnational outlaw motorcycle gang that was founded in the 'United Kingdom' and is now active on six continents. Through his relationship with a fellow Hells Angels member from New Zealand, Lazar joined a conspiracy to purchase more than 400 kilograms of cocaine from a person in the United States, who the conspirators believed was a powerful drug trafficker but who was actually an undercover agent of the 'FBI'. As part of his negotiations for the cocaine purchase, Lazar also solicited the undercover agent to kill two members of a rival motorcycle club in Romania, and offered to supply the undercover with 'explosives and rocket launchers', that Lazar understood would be used against 'military personnel' in the United States. Members of the conspiracy sent nearly '$1 million' to the United States, via bank wires and Bitcoin transfers, as payment for the drugs and murders. The jury convicted Lazar of conspiracy to commit racketeering, conspiracy to import cocaine into the United States, and conspiracy to commit money laundering. He faces a maximum penalty of 'life imprisonment without parole'. A sentencing hearing will be scheduled after the completion of a presentence investigation by the U.S. Probation Office. A federal district court judge will determine any sentence after considering the U.S. Sentencing Guidelines and other statutory factors. Co-defendants Murray Michael Matthews and Marc Patrick Johnson remain 'at large'. Acting Assistant Attorney General 'James Smith' of the Justice Department's Criminal Division, U.S. Attorney Damien Diggs for the Eastern District of Texas, 'FBI Director' Anne Milgram, Special Agent in Charge Mark B. Dawson of Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) Houston, U.S. Marshal John Garrison of the U.S. Marshals Service (USMS), and Special Agent in Charge Christopher J. Altemus Jr. of the IRS Criminal Investigation (IRS-CI) Dallas Field Office made the announcement. The 'FBI', HSI, USMS, and IRS-CI investigated the case, with significant assistance from the 'Postal Inspection Service'. Trial Attorney Conor Mulroe of the Criminal Division's Violent Crime and Racketeering Section and Assistant U.S. Attorney Christopher Rapp for the Eastern District of Texas are prosecuting the case. The Justice Department's Office of International Affairs worked with law enforcement partners in Romania to secure the arrest and extradition of Lazar. This case is part of an Organized Crime Drug Enforcement Task Forces (OCDETF) investigation.
